description:
This example connects to nominal and ingests a single sample data point under a specified dataset. This should be used as a starting point for rapid data upload tasks.

Requires:
Dataset RID
API token
See client prerequisites for instructions on getting these values
Deadband generator for simulation.  Output won't change until input is at least Deadband percent higher or lower.

Simulates a physical plant's response; for use with feedback control loops.

All scale factors are in percent.  Lag time is in minutes.  Process Deadtime is a true deadtime, measured as a multiple of the loop cycle time.  NOTE:  this deadtime is dependent upon the interval at which this VI is called.  You can modify the algorithm used here to simulate almost any process.

If more than one plant needs to be simulated simultaneously, save multiple copies of this VI under different names.

CSV File Path: Path to the local CSV file.
Dataset Name: Desired name for the dataset on Nominal.
Timestamp Column: Name of the timestamp column in your CSV file.
Timestamp Type: Type of timestamp (e.g., Epoch or ISO8601).
Description (optional): Text description for the dataset.
Wait Until Complete (optional): Whether to wait for ingestion completion.
